question: What Is the Difference Between Shielded Cable and Twisted Pair?
body_html:
Shielded cable and twisted pair both reduce noise on low level signals, but each blocks a different type of interference.

TechniqueNoise it stopsKey rule
Shield (foil or braid)Electric field noiseMust be tied to ground
Twisted pairMagnetic field noiseTwisting cancels induced voltage
Shielded twisted pairBoth typesAnalog shield grounded at one end only

Grounding an analog shield at both ends lets shield current induce noise.
